passage: The migration to the new billing system completed overnight with no lost transactions. About 3 percent of customers may see duplicate invoice emails because a notification job restarted unexpectedly; they have not been charged twice. Support has a response template, and engineering will suppress remaining duplicate messages within the hour.

keyPoints.text: The billing migration completed without lost transactions or duplicate charges.
About 3% of customers may receive duplicate invoice emails.
Engineering will suppress remaining duplicates within the hour.

referenceAnswer: Billing migrated without lost transactions; 3% of customers may get duplicate invoices but were not charged twice.
